description: This PHP source file defines a helper class `PhpBrowserDriverHelper` within the `Helper` namespace, extending the Codeception `Module` class. It provides methods to retrieve configuration and environment variables related to database settings, URL, and authentication credentials for SuiteCRM testing. The class appears to facilitate environment configuration management for automated tests.

classes.name: PhpBrowserDriverHelper
classes.description: A helper class for retrieving configuration and environment variables for SuiteCRM testing, extending the Codeception Module class.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the 'PhpBrowser' module.

methods.name: getInstanceURL
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_URL' environment variable or default URL 'http://localhost'.

methods.name: getDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the 'DATABASE_DRIVER' environment variable or default database driver from `DatabaseDriver::MYSQL`.

methods.name: getDatabaseName
methods.description: Retrieves the 'DATABASE_NAME' environment variable or default 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabaseHost
methods.description: Retrieves the 'DATABASE_HOST' environment variable or default 'database_host'.

methods.name: getDatabaseUser
methods.description: Retrieves the 'DATABASE_USER' environment variable or default 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getDatabasePassword
methods.description: Retrieves the 'DATABASE_PASSWORD' environment variable or default 'automated_tests'.

methods.name: getAdminUser
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_ADMIN_USER' environment variable or default 'admin'.

methods.name: getAdminPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_ADMIN_PASSWORD' environment variable or default 'admin'.

methods.name: getPasswordGrantClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_CLIENT_ID' environment variable or default client ID string.

methods.name: getPasswordGrantClientSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_CLIENT_SECRET' environment variable or default secret.

methods.name: getClientCredentialsGrantClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_CREDENTIALS_CLIENT_ID' environment variable or default client ID string.

methods.name: getClientCredentialsGrantClientSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the 'INSTANCE_CREDENTIALS_CLIENT_SECRET' environment variable or default secret.

methods.name: getEnvironmentVariableOrDefault
methods.description: Helper method to get the environment variable or fallback to the default from config.
